issues.description: The problem statement text requires the Animal.name attribute to be a StringBuilder for performance reasons, but the UML in the same problem statement shows name: String, and the provided solution implements name as a String. This inconsistency (text vs UML vs solution) can confuse students about which type to use for the Animal.name attribute and how to implement the getter/setter.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended attribute type consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) Update the problem statement (text and UML) to specify name as String and remove the StringBuilder requirement; or (B) change the solution and UML to use StringBuilder for the name, and update the Animal getter/setter signatures/implementations accordingly (e.g., return String or StringBuilder consistently and document expected usage). Ensure the template and example code (Main) also reflect the chosen type.
